messages:
tim (sales): Heads up — ACME POC hitting intermittent 429s during bulk embeddings import starting ~09:05 PT. Need triage before EOD. @ajay @derek
sara (ACME): Jobs are stuck in our UI, some complete but lots retrying. Request id 9f3b7a2e shown in logs.
ajay (eng): Can you paste a sample request and the full response headers? Also, how many concurrent workers are they running?
tim (sales): sample curl + response below:
```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":["...big blob..."]}'
```
response snippet:
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-request-id: 9f3b7a2e
x-rate-limit-limit: 10000
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 2612347000
body: {\"error\":\"rate limit\",\"code\":\"route_concurrency_exceeded\"}
sara (ACME): Client spawns 20 parallel threads, each sends batches of ~500 rows. They assumed account-level quota only.
ajay (eng): Notes: that response code and the body key point to the per-route concurrency limiter for /v1/embeddings (we meter token-equivalents there). Large batches + 20 parallel workers will exhaust the route token bucket quickly. The x-rate-limit-remaining 0 is account-level, but the error text is from the route gate.
ajay (eng): Quick checks: are they using the standard embeddings endpoint (not a batched-multi variant) and are they compressing payloads?
sara (ACME): confirmed standard endpoint, no compression yet.
derek (sre): Short-term mitigation: instruct client to throttle concurrency to 4 and add exponential backoff + jitter. That should eliminate most 429s immediately. We can also apply a temporary per-tenant soft bump for the demo window if needed. @jess any billing/security flags?
jess (solutions): Temp bump OK for 24h but need rough cost delta and signoff from finance. Also record in the playbook.
ajay (eng): Rough numbers: current observed throughput ~3M token-equivalents/hour. Recommend bump to allow +1M tokens/hour headroom for the demo. Ballpark cost ~ $120/hr at current hosted pricing. I'll prepare a minimal change to increase the route bucket for tenant acme-pt1 and can canary it.
tim (sales): We need this unblocked for a 15:00 PT demo. Canary + rollback plan please. Also share expected billing impact to ACME so account team can pre-approve.
ajay (eng): Starting canary now — small config change to route limiter for tenant acme-pt1.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for tenant acme-pt1 (config: route_limit +1M tokens/hr).
deploy-bot: canary health checks passing (2/2).
sara (ACME): Testing now — importing same file with 20 threads. No 429s after 10 minutes, progress looks steady :thumbsup:.
tim (sales): Awesome — keep monitoring. We'll revert after demo unless they ask to keep it. Please capture the change window for audit.
derek (sre): Note: added follow-up to presales playbook at /docs/presales/playbooks/poc-embeddings-ratecap.md with recommended client settings (concurrency 4, batch size 128, compress payloads) and temporary bump process.
jess (solutions): Sent cost estimate to finance and CC'd account team.
ajay (eng): Rolling revert scheduled for 26xxxxx7200 unless ACME requests extension. Will notify 30m before revert.
sara (ACME): Confirming demo went fine, no more 429s, thanks everyone.
tim (sales): Closing this thread — marking as resolved unless regressions. Thanks team :tada:
